jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) CEDAR WOOD HAND CREAM
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented hand cream. Bottle with a pump dispenser.

Cedar Wood | The aromas of the traditional apothecary—floral, woody, and sweet—merge to create a modern, contemporary collection of fragrances. Citrusy and floral, discover its woody base, subtly sweetened by a touch of sugarcane.

Notes:
Top notes: citrus, mandarin, grapefruit.
Heart notes: floral, freesia, jasmine.
Base notes: aromatic, cedar wood, sugarcane.
